correction: The initial A12 patent chart and first H1 preregistration understated the current repository. A production-oriented v6 scheduler path already separates semantic recovery from infrastructure retry and excludes the failed independent model family when choosing semantic recovery. The new CIR cause_conditioned_recovery adapter makes the classification/operator contract explicit and directly ablatable, but it is not the first implementation of the behavioral idea in this repository.

behavior.semantic_failure: schedules AttemptKind.RECOVERY, excludes the failed recipe independent family, and advances recovery scope/candidate family under a bounded recovery budget
behavior.infrastructure_failure: schedules AttemptKind.RETRY, records infrastructure health/drain evidence, and retries on another worker/model family
behavior.recovery_acceptance: binds base and repair independent-family identities plus source evidence into RecoveryCandidate before acceptance

claim_boundary: This confirms implementation behavior, not empirical superiority. The paired quality/cost ablation remains unrun.
